questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: 'Customise your Bumps' title with 'Choose days', 'Duration' and 'Bumps per day' makes the screen's job clear.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The teal 'Bump' button next to '4,400' coins in the footer is the single strong action.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: Day chips and duration chips predict their effect, but the 'Choose timings' switch doesn't say what turning it on reveals or changes.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: '1w', '4w', '24w', '52w' abbreviations and the 'Biz' badge are shorthand, though 'Bumps' itself is familiar to this seller.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: Days and duration are easy calls, but 'Bumps per day' (1–8) plus timings asks for scheduling decisions a seller can't easily weigh without knowing the effect on views.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: 'Choose timings' is tucked behind a switch, but the bumps-per-day slider and its explanation are shown to everyone up front.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: All controls configure the Bump purchase; the CarouBiz savings line relates to its price.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Chips and stepper carry most of it, but 'The first Bump happens at the time you buy the Bump. The second Bump happens 3 hours later.' must be read to understand the slider.
